findings.impact: Authentication fails if relying on 'token' field. Session expires much earlier than expected.

findings.documented: Every request must carry the API key... Append it as a query parameter: ?api_key=...
findings.actual: The API key must be sent in the 'X-API-Key' header.
findings.how_found: Received 401 error when passing api_key in query parameters.
findings.impact: All API calls fail until headers are corrected.

findings.documented: No authentication required for /v1/listings (api_key is sufficient)
findings.actual: Requires Bearer token from /auth/login to access /v1/listings.
findings.how_found: Received 'missing bearer token - log in at POST /auth/login first' error.
findings.impact: Frontend must enforce login before any data can be fetched.

findings.actual: Collection endpoints use 'offset' and 'limit'. 'page' is completely ignored.
findings.how_found: Passing page=1 and page=2 returned the same results. offset=5 returned different results.
findings.impact: Infinite loops or duplicated data if relying on the 'page' parameter.

findings.actual: Maximum limit is silently clamped to 50.
findings.how_found: Requested limit=200 but results array length was strictly 50.
findings.impact: Requires 4x more requests to fetch data than expected.

findings.actual: These fields are missing (undefined) in the response.
findings.how_found: Inspecting the root JSON keys of paginated responses.
findings.impact: Frontend pagination logic cannot rely on these fields.

findings.documented: Money: Indian rupees, integer, everywhere in the API
findings.actual: project price_min and price_max are floats in Lacs or Crores, not integer rupees.
findings.how_found: Observed prices like 1.95 and 66.1 for projects, which are clearly Crores/Lacs, not INR.
findings.impact: Prices are drastically misrepresented if treated as raw INR.

findings.documented: Every listing_id is globally unique, and each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property.
findings.actual: Multiple listing_ids correspond to the exact same physical property (same attributes).
findings.how_found: Grouped listings by apartment_name, locality, floor, carpet_area and found exact duplicates.
findings.impact: Inflates available inventory and confuses users.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive, expired and withdrawn listings are excluded server side
findings.actual: Returns inactive listings (is_live: false) as well.
findings.how_found: Iterated through records and found many with is_live === false.
findings.impact: Frontend must manually filter active listings.

findings.documented: All listings are genuine properties for sale.
findings.actual: Some listings exist merely to generate enquiries with unreasonably low prices (fake).
findings.how_found: Filtered for extremely low price_per_sqft and found multiple fake listings.
findings.impact: Degrades user trust and data quality.

findings.actual: Contains mathematically impossible properties (negative price, floor > total_floors, carpet_area > super_built_up).
findings.how_found: Programmatically verified constraints against all listings.
findings.impact: Causes UI bugs or confusing display values if not cleaned.

findings.how_found: Attempted to fetch single listing using documented path.
findings.impact: Detail pages will fail to load.

findings.actual: This is the correct path for a single listing.

findings.how_found: Attempted to fetch similar listings for a valid listing_id.
findings.impact: Similar properties feature cannot be implemented server-side.

findings.documented: Timestamps | ISO 8601, UTC, Z suffix, everywhere in the API
findings.actual: Timestamps lack the Z suffix and are likely in IST based on health endpoint offset.
findings.how_found: Observed posted_at missing the Z suffix (e.g. 2026-03-27T20:02:00).
findings.impact: Date parsing logic assumes local time instead of UTC, causing timezone bugs.

findings.documented: 'total' is the exact number of records matching your filters.
findings.actual: Total is 3840 but 4100 records are retrievable.
findings.how_found: Paginating to the end returns more records than the 'total' field indicates.
findings.impact: Pagination math (total / limit) will result in missing pages.
